company.name: Rocket Money
company.shortDescription: Rocket Money is the easiest way to find subscriptions, manage bills, and even cancel recurring charges with a single click.
company.description: Rocket Money (formerly Truebill) is a leading personal finance app with the mission to empower people to live their best financial lives. The company offers its members a unique understanding of their finances and a suite of valuable services that save them time and money – ultimately giving their members a leg up on their financial journey. Members can manage subscriptions, lower their bills, build budgets and automatically set aside money to reach their savings goals.

productsAndServices.description: A service that identifies and tracks recurring subscriptions and bills linked to a user's financial accounts.
productsAndServices.name: Subscription Management

productsAndServices.description: A service that identifies bills eligible for reduction and negotiates lower rates on behalf of the user.
productsAndServices.name: Bill Negotiation

productsAndServices.description: An automated savings feature that analyzes user accounts to save money at optimal times, helping users reach their financial goals while avoiding overdraft fees.
productsAndServices.name: Financial Goals (Autopilot Savings)

productsAndServices.description: A tool that provides a detailed breakdown of users' spending patterns across linked accounts to help understand and manage expenses.
productsAndServices.name: Spending Insights

productsAndServices.description: A feature that allows users to create and monitor budgets by category to track spending and stay on financial goals.
productsAndServices.name: Budgeting

productsAndServices.description: A service that provides access to users' credit reports and scores, with alerts for significant changes affecting credit health.
productsAndServices.name: Credit Score Monitoring

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series D round raised $45,000,000, or 53.57% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $500,000,000 to $500,000,000, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
